about: Villheim piece catalog: one record per vanilla prefab placed in the corpus (compact.json, 2,128 builds) or by the generator. Built by data/catalog/tools/build_catalog.py; fields in data/catalog/README.md, method in docs/PIECE_CATALOG.md.

plank.label: Plank wood
plank.look: Light honey to mid brown sawn planks with gray weathering on the worn side; the everyday building wood.

log.label: Round log
log.look: Whole pine logs, mid brown with darker bark and pale cut ends; chunky and rustic.

darkwood.label: Darkwood
darkwood.look: Near-black brown tarred wood; shingles and carved beams. Reads dark and heavy next to plank wood.

timber.label: Timber (Deep North)
timber.look: Warm mid brown boards and turned poles, lighter than darkwood; decorated beams with carved bead rows.

scalewood.label: Scalewood (Deep North)
scalewood.look: Mid brown boards laid as overlapping scales; walls and gables in the Deep North style.

ashwood.label: Ashwood
ashwood.look: Charcoal gray to black wood with a dusty gray top; ornate cut-out panels and arches.

woodiron.label: Wood and iron
woodiron.look: Brown beams wrapped in dark iron straps and rivets.

dvergr.label: Dvergr wood and copper
dvergr.look: Reddish brown planks with green-blue copper and brass fittings; Dvergr town props.

goblin.label: Fuling wood
goblin.look: Crude pale gray-tan sticks lashed together; Fuling camp props.

thatch.label: Straw thatch
thatch.look: Pale golden straw roofing; the light roof of early houses.

stone.label: Cut stone
stone.look: Chunky light gray blocks with rough faces; Tyler: "Stone is chunky and light gray."

grausten.label: Grausten
grausten.look: Smooth dark gray stone, thinner than cut stone; cracked surface; Tyler: "Grausten is smooth and dark gray and half the width."

marble.label: Black marble
marble.look: Near-black polished stone with thin gray veins; columns, cornices and Mistlands furniture.

iron.label: Iron
iron.look: Dark gray riveted iron plates and grates.

flametal.label: Flametal
flametal.finish: dark blue-gray metal with ember glow
flametal.look: Dark blue-gray metal; Ashlands gates and beams.

rustic_furniture.label: Rustic furniture
rustic_furniture.look: Honey to mid brown worn wood, simple cuts; stool, bench, plain table, workbench, chests, signs, item stands.

fine_furniture.label: Fine furniture
fine_furniture.look: Smoother, darker joined wood: wood chair, round table, long heavy table, prep table.

darkwood_furniture.label: Carved high-back wood (raven set)
darkwood_furniture.look: Carved honey to mid brown wood with tall backs: the "darkwood chair" (piece_chair03) and the raven throne. Lighter than the darkwood building pieces despite the game name.

grausten_tile.label: Grausten roof tiles
grausten_tile.look: Red-brown clay roof tiles over gray grausten edges; the Ashlands roof.

runed_furniture.label: Carved furniture (Deep North)
runed_furniture.look: Mid brown wood with carved knotwork; carved chair, bench and tables.

marble_furniture.label: Black marble furniture
marble_furniture.look: Near-black stone with a warm brown cushion or wood accent; bench, table, throne.

ashwood_furniture.label: Ashwood furniture
ashwood_furniture.look: Dark charcoal wood with gray dust: ashwood bed, bench, door.

dvergr_props.label: Dvergr props
dvergr_props.look: Red-brown Dvergr furniture and crates with copper bands; lanterns with warm amber glass.

hide.label: Hide and fur
hide.look: Animal skins and furs, from orange-brown deer hide to gray wolf fur.

cloth.label: Dyed cloth
cloth.look: Woven and dyed cloth: jute carpets and curtains, banners in solid and striped colors.

ceramic.label: Glazed ceramic
ceramic.look: Clay pots; green glaze, red glaze or cracked clay.

iron_props.label: Iron props
iron_props.look: Dark gray wrought iron: standing torches, braziers, iron grill, cauldron, iron chest bands.

stone_props.label: Stone props
stone_props.look: Rough gray stone: hearth, campfire ring, stone oven, stone throne.

forge_set.label: Forge set
forge_set.look: Sooty brown wood and dark iron: forge, bellows, anvils, grinding wheel, cooler, tool rack.

blackforge_set.label: Black forge set
blackforge_set.look: Dark metal stations with orange-hot accents.

galdr_set.label: Galdr table set
galdr_set.look: Dark stone tables with candles and purple-glowing runes; Tyler: "blackmarble and purple glowing accents".

kitchen_set.label: Kitchen set
kitchen_set.look: Cauldron upgrades and cooking gear: spice rack, butcher table, pots and pans, mortar, rolling pins.

workshop_set.label: Workbench set
workshop_set.look: Workbench and its add-ons: chopping block, tanning rack, adze, tool shelf.

gold.label: Gold
gold.look: Bright yellow gold coins and treasure.

yule.label: Yule and festival
yule.look: Seasonal decor: yule tree, wreaths, garlands, gifts, jack-o-turnip.

plant.label: Living plants
plant.look: Greenery: bushes, flowers, ferns, vines, saplings, trees.

food.label: Food and drink
food.look: Plates, pies, meat, berries, mead bottles and feasts.

resource_stack.label: Resource stacks
resource_stack.look: Stacks of wood, stone, coal, metal bars and coins.
